title: Deity
description: Reference schema for docs/timeline/SPEC.md §7.1's Deity/Being node type — with `identifications[]` (cross-culture equations, each sourced and confidence-rated) and `domain_history[]` (domains change over time; no single-word freezing). Entities aggregate claims; they assert nothing on their own — every substantive statement about a Deity lives in a linked Claim (subject_type: Deity, subject_id: this entity's id), not inline here. The hand-rolled validator (docs/timeline/scripts/validate-timeline.mjs) is authoritative if this file and the validator diverge.

identifications.description: Cross-culture equations (e.g. syncretic identifications made by practitioners or scholars), each independently sourced and confidence-rated — never asserted by mere name/domain similarity.

claim_id.description: The Claim that sources this identification.

domain_history.description: SPEC.md §7.1: domains change over time; no single-word freezing. Each entry needs a backing Claim.

claim_id.description: The Claim that sources this domain attribution for this period.
